title: fix(service-analytics): a hand-authored cube member naming a column its related object lacks answers 400 INVALID_FIELD, not a database error
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99NaHA8uVthXXC139JxE9ZB)_
Fixes #31881

Clause-②: no — a 500 becomes the 400 the same input already gets on the compiled-dataset path; nothing served changes, and no export, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手写分析立方上，按关联对象并不存在的字段查询（如 `vendor.nope`，或 vendor 没有 region 时的 `vendor.region`），现在在编译前被拒绝为 400 字段无效，并点名成员和关联对象；以前原生 SQL 策略会拼出 JOIN 后报 500 数据库错误。
- 为什么改：同样的输入走编译后的数据集路径早就被同一道关联字段闸门拒为 400；手写立方路径因为没有 include 白名单而跳过了这道闸门。现在两条路径问的是同一道闸门、同一句话。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽闸门的一个提前返回条件，并在调用处传入原生策略本来就执行的白名单；存在的关联字段照常关联和筛选。只动 `@objectstack/service-analytics`，回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` 的 `assertRelationshipColumnsExist`（`!allowed` 不再提前返回）与 `callCtx` 中它的调用处（改传 `getAllowedRelationships`）；测试 `dotted-dimension-unbacked-join-parity.test.ts` 末尾新增的 `[#31881]` 块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/dotted-dimension-unbacked-join-parity.test.ts`，应见 24 个用例全绿，其中末尾 3 个是本卡新加的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts`, one gate, no second copy of the rule:

- **The gate** is `AnalyticsService.assertRelationshipColumnsExist` (#28558), the related-column gate the compiled-dataset path already asks in `callCtx`. It returned early when `allowed` (the compiled dataset's `allowedRelationships`) was `undefined`, which is every hand-authored cube. It now runs on every cube; the `include`-backed check inside it (`unbackedRelationshipPath`) runs only when there is an allowlist.
- **The call site in `callCtx`** passes `reads.getAllowedRelationships(query.cube)`, the allowlist the native strategy itself enforces for that cube (`cubeReads`: a compiled dataset's `include`, else the configured `getAllowedRelationships` hook, else none). So a compiled dataset gets exactly the set it got before, and on a hand-authored cube with the legacy hook a path the hook does not back keeps the strategy's own `DATASET_INVALID`, as an unbacked path keeps `assertDimensionJoinsBacked`'s refusal on the dataset path. `assertDimensionJoinsBacked` and the draft-preview call site are unchanged.
- **The refusal** is the gate's own: `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 via `invalidMemberError`, `member` / `param` / `cube` plus `field` and `object`, in the dataset path's sentence ("Filter member 'vendor.nope' on cube 'CUBE' reads field 'nope' through relationship path 'vendor', which object 'VENDOR' does not have. …"). No new code, status or envelope.

Reach of the gate (seat ruling 3), measured on `80c4c9a2` and on the fix with the same harness:

| Input on a hand-authored cube | Native before | Native after | Engine-aggregate before | Engine-aggregate after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `vendor.nope` / `vendor.region` as a `where` leaf | 500 `DATABASE_ERROR` | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (gate) | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (cross-object filter refusal) | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (gate) |
| … as a dimension | 500 `DATABASE_ERROR` | 400 (gate) | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (engine group-by guard) | 400 (gate) |
| … as a windowed time dimension | 500 `DATABASE_ERROR` | 400 (gate) | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (cross-object bucket refusal) | 400 (gate) |
| … as a bucketed time dimension | 400 `INVALID_FIELD` (cross-object bucket refusal) | 400 (gate) | same as native | 400 (gate) |
| `supplier.region` / `supplier.since` (column exists) | served | served, unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |
| `nope.region` (no relationship field `nope` on the cube's object) | 500 `DATABASE_ERROR` | unchanged | 400 (its own refusals) | unchanged |
| a cube whose `sql` is a statement (`SELECT * FROM deal`), `vendor.*` | 500 `DATABASE_ERROR` | unchanged | 400 / 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | unchanged |

- **Unknown hop** (`nope.region`): the hop resolver names an object called `nope` (the alias tier), the field probe has no answer for it, and the gate stands down, as it does on the dataset path. The dataset path refuses this input through a different gate (`assertDimensionJoinsBacked`, "traverses relationship path 'nope', which the dataset does not declare in its include"), which judges the `include` a hand-authored cube does not have; the related-column gate itself never refuses it. So per ruling 3 it keeps its native answer (500); listed in open questions.
- **Raw `sql` cube**: the gate needs the cube's object name and stands down (`BARE_IDENTIFIER`), unchanged.
- **Engine-aggregate face**: the same inputs were already 400 `INVALID_FIELD`; they now get the gate's sentence (naming the member and the related object) in place of three different ones.

## Tests

New top-level `describe('[#31881] …')` at the end of the shared #28258 harness, `src/__tests__/dotted-dimension-unbacked-join-parity.test.ts` (real SQLite, `AnalyticsServicePlugin` on both strategies, a hand-authored cube named apart from its object, no allowlist):

- `vendor.nope` and `vendor.region` (vendor has no `region`) answer 400 `INVALID_FIELD` on the native strategy as a `where` leaf, a dimension and a windowed time dimension: `code`, `status`, `param`, `member`, `field` and `object`.
- On both strategies the cube's refusal message equals the compiled dataset's refusal for the same member (`include: ['vendor', 'supplier']`), with only the cube name differing.
- CONTROL: `supplier.region` still joins and filters (`{region: emea, count: 2}`) and groups (`apac: 2`, `emea: 1`) on the native strategy.
- #31878's and #31899's pins in the same file: unedited and green (24/24).

**Forced test edit** (one): `src/__tests__/field-read-admission-gate.test.ts`, "judges only names the object's field list carries, and every name when that list is unavailable". Its first leg pinned a hand-authored cube query with `owner.not_a_field` (a related column the object's field list does not carry) EXECUTING on the native strategy. That is the input this card now refuses, so the leg now expects 400 `INVALID_FIELD` naming `owner.not_a_field` / `fr_owner` / `not_a_field` and nothing executed. Its claim (the read gate answers no 403 for an unlisted name) still holds; the second leg (no field list ⇒ 403) is unedited.

<details><summary>Red on main, then ablation (mutation landed via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import package source, no dist leg)</summary>

- **Red on main**: `analytics-service.ts` restored to the `80c4c9a2` blob (`584d6803`), `-t 31881`: 2 failed | 1 passed (the CONTROL). `AssertionError: where vendor.nope: The database refused to run a raw statement. … expected 'DATABASE_ERROR' to be 'INVALID_FIELD'`; `native vendor.nope: … expected 'DATABASE_ERROR' to be 'INVALID_FIELD'`. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- **Ablation, skip the gate on the cube path** (`if (!probe || !cube) return;` → `if (!probe || !cube || !allowed) return;`, i.e. main's early return): `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 9bba3366c6bb -> a829f3584788`. Whole harness file: 2 failed | 22 passed (24), the two #31881 400 pins back to `DATABASE_ERROR` (500); every #28258 / #31842 / #31880 pin green. `ok restored: blob == HEAD (9bba3366c6bb) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The bucketed time-dimension row reads "ObjectQLStrategy cannot bucket a cross-object time dimension" on the NATIVE face on `main` for every dotted time dimension, `supplier.since` included (an existing column). That is the native strategy delegating cross-object bucketing (`cross-object-rebucket.ts`), not this card; recorded only.
